Email Manglo support ↗

Your email app will open so you can send your message. You can also copy the address above into your preferred email service.

For a useful bug report

  • Tell us which tool you used.
  • Include your browser, device and the steps that caused the issue.
  • Describe what you expected and what happened instead.
  • For image issues, share the file format and dimensions rather than private files.

Do not post passwords, private photos, customer details or financial records. There is no live chat or guaranteed response time.
